item.title: How to Ask a Good Question
item.description: 1. Motivation for Asking Questions There are two kinds of motivation for asking questions: passive and active. 2 Passive Passive questioning is the forced action you take when you run into a problem, search for a solution, and come up empty. 2.1 Try to Solve It Yourself When you hit a problem, do not rush to ask others.
